Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_Enabled_tooltip: Master kill switch. When disabled, no drops occur.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_DespawnTimer_tool: Minutes before the crate disappears. 0 = the crate stays in the world forever.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_MinDistance_toolt: Closest the drop can land from the players.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_MaxDistance_toolt: Farthest the drop can land from the players.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_SpawnRadius_toolt: The crate only materialises once a player gets this close to the landing zone.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_GuardianCount_too: How many Bandits guard the crate. 0 disables them. If the Bandits mod is missing, zombies are used instead.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_LootQuantity_tool: Maximum number of items inside a crate.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_CrateCapacity_too: Slots the crate can hold (a big military crate is around 75). Every item takes at least one slot.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_PriorityChance_to: Chance of getting one special item (suppressor, scope, Snake accessory) inside the crate. 0 = never.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_BanditsGuardians_: Spawn Bandits NPCs around the crate. When disabled no mob is spawned at all.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_GunsOfMarz_toolti: Add Guns of Marz weapons and weapon parts to the crates.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_SnakeLoot_tooltip: Add Snake's ModPack weapons and accessories to the crates.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_SpawnZombies_tool: If there are no Bandits guardians (integration disabled or mod not installed) spawn plain zombies instead. Disabled = only the crate.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_ALifeGuardians_to: If there are no Bandits guardians, use the Project A-Life NPCs (guard mode, hostile). Requires the Project A-Life mod installed and enabled in the save.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_ShowMapMarker_too: Draw the drop location on the world map.
Sandbox_KnoxAirSupport_PlaySound_tooltip: Play a sound when the crate lands.
